items: Agents: ==**water** most powerful==, then wind, ice, gravity

boxes.title: Landslide conditions

India's main trigger: **SW monsoon** rain, then earthquakes

boxes.title: Soil formation
items: ==Active factors: **climate, biological activity**== (APPSC G1 2024); passive: parent material, relief, time
Texture: sand **2-0.05 mm**, silt, clay < **0.002 mm**; water holding **clay > silt > sand**
**In-situ = sedentary** (APPSC 2018), Peninsula; transported: alluvium **45.6%** of India
AP: red ~**60%** (⚠ older notes: 66%), black ~**25%**, alluvium ~**6%**
